Timeline

Placement Timeline

  1. Westcliff Lodge 27/09/2022 11/04/2023
    Westcliff Lodge is described as a Residential Care Home for the Elderly. The contract was signed on behalf of Westcliff Lodge on 28 September 2022 (one day after the 27 September 2022 admission). The fee fields in the template are blank in this copy. This confirms the Westcliff Lodge placement and its residential character.
  2. Palmerston Care Home 11/04/2022 present
    The address is 23-25 Palmerston Road — not 21 The Council's own placement contract names Palmerston House at 23-25 Palmerston Road. The CQC registration and the ICB letter give the address as 21 Palmerston Road. The Land Registry shows 23-25 Palmerston Road is owned by Higgins Property Investments, while 21 Palmerston Road (the CQC-registered Palmerston House Care Home) is owned by Tekin and Gulhan. There is an address inconsistency in the Council's own documents about which building Bridget is actually in.

General Timeline

Private evidential record supporting the LGSCO investigation into Southend-on-Sea City Council's Adult Social Care handling of Mrs Bridget Penelope Walker's care, funding, and assessment.

  1. Apr 2020
    Kira Walker emails Council Dementia Community Support Team describing Bridget's wandering. Council sends activity pack only — no assessment, no safeguarding referral, no CHC consideration.
  2. 27 Jul 2020
    Mark Walker submits Supported Self-Assessment (Service Request 6614531). Savings declared above £23,250.
  3. 6 Sep 2020
    Bridget absconds from Sweyne Court, reaches Rayleigh High Street barefoot. CQC and safeguarding lead Jo Allen notified. 24-hour 1:1 care imposed; family told to fund it (£4,460.65). Jo Allen: Council not obliged as Bridget is private.
  4. 11–16 Sep 2020
    Hallmark (Admiral Court — registered nursing home) admits Bridget c.16 Sep 2020 at £1,450/week. Placement begins as respite; becomes permanent due to Covid-19. Transfer care plan records her 'at low risk of leaving the home unnoticed' — 10 days after the absconding incident.
  5. 10 Nov 2020
    DoLS Standard Authorisation granted at Admiral Court. Lack of capacity confirmed; continuous supervision; not free to leave. Kira Walker appointed RPR.
  6. 2020–2022
    Bridget privately funded at Admiral Court (nursing home) at £1,450/week. No FNC. No CHC referral. Capital depleted from above £23,250 to below £14,250. Overdue balance reaches £12,842.86; final account 5 Oct 2022.
  7. 27–28 Sep 2022
    Transfer to Westcliff Lodge (residential care home). Westcliff Lodge resident contract signed 28 Sep 2022. Council formally involved under Care Act 2014. 12-week property disregard begins.
  8. 26 Oct 2022
    CHC Checklist #1 (Jacquie Deacon). Threshold not met. Incorrect age (75) and wrong address (Palmerston House — a home Bridget would not move to for nearly 6 months). Family never notified.
  9. 7 Nov 2022
    ASC Assessment #1. Incorrect age (75) and Palmerston address — impossible at this date.
  10. 15 Nov 2022
    Westcliff Lodge manager (Nicky Bourouisa) warns in writing of high-dependency behaviours requiring specialist placement. Same month as CHC Checklist #1.
  11. Dec 2022
    DPA purportedly commences 19/20 Dec 2022. Council charges £800/wk contributions AND defers £389.77/wk simultaneously — combined £1,189.77/wk against actual fee of £738.46/wk.
  12. 1 Feb 2023
    CHC Checklist #2. Threshold not met. Incorrect age and Palmerston address — impossible at this date. Family never notified.
  13. 16 Feb 2023
    DPA Application Form signed by Mark Walker. Section 3c declares dependent occupants of 84 Bellhouse Road: Mark Walker, Victoria Walker, and Alex James Walker (dependent child). Property value £425,000.
  14. 22 Feb 2023
    ASC Assessment #2. Incorrect age and Palmerston address — impossible at this date.
  15. 11 Apr 2023
    Transfer to Palmerston House. Council Individual Placement Contract created (Word metadata: created 13 Apr 2023) showing Council fully funding £750/week, £0 from resident. Care Manager: Jacquie Deacon. Address stated as 23-25 Palmerston Road. No needs assessment, care plan or review at transfer.
  16. 15 May 2023
    Unwitnessed fall — hip fracture. Hospital admission and surgery. No CHC assessment at discharge.
  17. 19 May 2023
    DPA signed — naming Westcliff Lodge despite Bridget having moved to Palmerston House 38 days earlier. PDF metadata shows scanned 17 May 2023, two days before stated execution date.
